sentences.text: The bank documents conflict on whether any pre-payment charge applies, because the home loan agreement says the charge is 2% of the amount prepaid and the Key Facts Statement says pre-payment / foreclosure charges are Nil.
If the 2% charge applies, the charge on Rs 10,00,000 prepaid is {{calc:1}}.
